learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to capture the amazing movements of dance by drawing bent arms, kicking legs, and action lines!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we dance, our bodies bend and stretch! We can draw stick figures with bent elbows and knees to show that they are dancing fast.
Want to make your drawing look like it is moving? Add little 'swoosh' lines next to the hands and feet of your dancer!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Stick Figure Dance Crew
fun_activity.instructions: Draw three stick figures holding hands. Make one jumping, one bending, and one spinning!

quick_recap: ⭐ Bending the arms and legs in a drawing shows movement.
⭐ Action lines help our art look alive and full of energy.
⭐ Every dance pose is just a combination of simple lines and shapes.
